# Mia AI

Mia AI is an embodied AI digital operator and mission orchestrator. Stop asking AI how. Tell Mia what to do.

## Core pages
- https://mohammedabdelshafy.github.io/mia-ai-site/
- https://mohammedabdelshafy.github.io/mia-ai-site/ai-employee/
- https://mohammedabdelshafy.github.io/mia-ai-site/ai-agent-swarm/
- https://mohammedabdelshafy.github.io/mia-ai-site/ai-automation/

## Positioning
Mia turns plain-language outcomes into visible missions: understand, plan, route specialists, use connected tools, execute, verify, and deliver the result.

## Topics
AI employee, AI agent swarm, AI automation, MCP tools, digital operations, research automation, build automation, outreach automation.
